author: Rahul M.
text: Amazing sound quality and fast delivery! Got it in 8 minutes. 100% genuine product with warranty card.

author: Priya S.
text: Good earbuds for the price. The bass is decent but not exceptional. Love the 10 min delivery though.

author: Amit K.
text: Very convenient to get electronics delivered so quickly. Product was sealed and authentic boAt.

author: Neha V.
text: Average battery life. Didn't last the claimed 42 hours. But it's okay for daily gym use.

author: Karan D.
text: Best TWS under 1500! Pairing is instant. Delivered fast and perfectly packed.

author: Sneha R.
text: Comfortable fit in ears. Mic is okay for calls in quiet rooms, picks up background noise outdoors.

author: Arjun P.
text: Right earbud stopped working after 2 weeks. Returned it easily though, good customer support.

author: Meera T.
text: Saved me before a trip! Lost my old ones, ordered these on Blinkit and got them before leaving.

author: Vikram S.
text: Good value for money. Looks premium and feels sturdy. Audio is crisp.

author: Pooja N.
text: Authentic product verified on boAt website. Cheaper than Amazon with instant delivery!

author: Rohan B.
text: Case got scratched easily. Didn't like the build quality of the charging case.

author: Anjali G.
text: Superb bass and loud volume. Love listening to music on these. Quick delivery by Blinkit.

author: Siddharth M.
text: Nice earbuds. Gaming mode works well, latency is barely noticeable.

author: Tanya C.
text: A bit bulky for my small ears. Tends to slip out while running.

author: Vivek A.
text: Great product. Touch controls are very responsive. Highly recommend.

author: Kavita J.
text: Original boAt product with 1 year warranty. Happy to see electronics on Blinkit.

author: Deepak H.
text: Sometimes disconnects randomly from my iPhone. Quite annoying.

author: Simran K.
text: Loved the ASAP charge feature. 5 mins charge gives almost an hour playback.

author: Raj L.
text: Good for the price. Not noise cancelling but isolates sound well enough.

author: Nisha W.
text: Perfect for daily commute. Battery lasts for days without needing a case recharge.
